title: Intentional-stub allowlist
description: Suppressions for the stub/TODO/placeholder count lane (bin/stub-detect.mjs). Applied by loadAllowlist() there; a document that fails this schema takes the same path a corrupt one already takes — allowlistUnreadable, nothing suppressed, and the reason printed. The shape is the one this file's own _comment declares: {pathGlob, marker?, repo?, reason}. Top-level keys other than `allow` must be underscore-prefixed STRINGS, which is what makes a mistyped `allowe: [...]` a refusal rather than a silently empty allowlist beside a note nobody reads.

pathGlob.description: Matched against the repo-relative forward-slashed path; * is a non-slash run, ** is any run.

marker.description: OPTIONAL, and its absence is a real and much broader meaning: every marker on the matched path is suppressed, which the file's own _comment says is almost never what an entry intends. Absence is therefore not a missing value and is not required. Type only, no enum: the marker names live in MARKERS in bin/stub-detect.mjs and a copy here could not notice that list moving. A marker that is not in MARKERS still suppresses nothing, silently — remaining debt, and the fix belongs in stub-detect.mjs where the list is.

repo.description: Scopes the entry to one scanned tree. ABSENT means commitwork's own tree only — a real scope, so not required.

reason.description: Required, and non-trivial. Same floor bin/test/schema-required.test.mjs applies to an inventory row's reason: a suppression with no stated ground is an omission wearing the shape of a decision. The 37 entries in the live file run 129-425 characters, so this refuses nothing that exists.
